courses.name: Furry Creek Golf & Country Club
courses.notes: Booked through Chronogolf (Lightspeed Golf). $25/player fee for no-shows or cancellations within 24h.

courses.name: Northlands Golf Course
courses.notes: Public bookings open 5 days ahead at 7:00am (online). 6-90 days ahead costs a non-refundable $10/player fee.

courses.name: Northview Golf & Country Club
courses.notes: Two 18-hole courses (Ridge and Canal). Booked through Chronogolf.

courses.name: Morgan Creek Golf Course
courses.notes: Tee times released daily at 5:00am. Course site books through CPS; Chronogolf listing used as a fallback.

courses.name: Mayfair Lakes Golf & Country Club
courses.notes: GolfBC course on Total e Integrated. Public can view 8 days ahead; account needed to book. No public JSON feed, so this app links out.

providers.reason: Total e Integrated booking site has no public availability API

courses.name: The Redwoods Golf Course
courses.notes: Public can book 10 days ahead. Booking runs through the course site / Gallus Golf app; no public availability API found, so this app links out.

providers.reason: Redwoods booking engine has no public availability API

courses.name: Kings Links by the Sea
courses.notes: Tee times open 7 days ahead at 8:00am. Legacy CPS v3 booking site (server-rendered).

courses.name: Fraserview Golf Course
courses.notes: City of Vancouver course. 5 days ahead from 7:00pm with no fee; 6-30 days ahead carries a booking fee. Booked through Chronogolf (also VanGolf app).
